integrity: Proof states the exact-distance propagation lemma, full factorial-moment argument, and separate endpoint law. Finite verification programs are supporting checks, not infinite proofs. Priority may be affected by unindexed random-intersection or lotto-design literature.
scientific_limitations: Fixed k>=4 only, independent uniform Bernoulli seed distribution, time indices >=2, weak-convergence only; separate t=1 not determined; no assertion of finite-n Poisson equality.
title: A hierarchy of Poisson consensus windows in disjunctive Johnson dynamics
